name: Reels from raw takes
description: Use when turning a raw talking-to-camera take into a phone reel: best take per line, a hook that stands alone, fillers out, the face kept in a 9:16 frame, captions people can read.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.
